description.text: The basic courses are: Listening, Composition, Speaking, Chinese Culture, Extensive Reading, etc.The elective courses are: HSK skills, Chinese Cooking, Chinese Martial Arts, Calligraphy, Painting, Seal Cutting, Music, Chinese Tourism and Culture, Movie Appreciation, Shanghai Dialect, etc.This course also provides Culture Activity and Field TripsCultural Activities: Forum with Chinese students, visiting places of interest in Shanghai. Field Trips: Visiting historical and Cultural places.

duration.text: The Long-Term Chinese Refresher Course at Shanghai JiaoTong University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Certificate/Diploma of highest educationThe certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized

requirements.text: 1. A valid passport.2. Aged from 18 to 55 and in good health.3. Abide by the laws of the People’s Republic of China and observe the rules and regulations of the university
